Freelance Application Penetration Testers | 100% remote | 12 months | European based 
 My client’s AppSec team is responsible for securing a portfolio of around 400 products and needs external support to test them. We’re looking for freelance pen testers to join the team remotely and work through the portfolio in a structured, prioritised way.
 Responsibilities 
Plan and run penetration tests on web applications, covering the OWASP Top 10, authentication and session management, access control, business logic flaws and API security (REST/SOAP)
Test desktop applications (thick clients), including local storage, traffic interception, DLL hijacking, privilege escalation and insecure communication with back-end services
Carry out black box and grey box testing, depending on the product
Manually validate findings rather than relying on scanner output alone
Rate vulnerabilities using CVSS and write clear reports with practical remediation guidance
Present findings to product owners and developers, and retest fixes
 Requirements 
Proven hands-on application pen testing experience at mid level
A recognised certification: OSCP, PNPT, BSCP, eCPPT or similar
Strong command of Burp Suite and common tooling (Nmap, sqlmap, ffuf, Postman)
Solid understanding of HTTP, web technologies and authentication protocols (OAuth, SAML, JWT)
Experience testing thick client / desktop applications
Clear, structured report writing
English first language
 Nice to have 
Mobile application pen testing (Android/iOS, MobSF, Frida)
Scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell)
Experience in regulated industries
 The details 
Fully remote, Europe-based
Romania based is a nice to have
4 or 5 days per week
Interviews taking place next week
Start ASAP
 If you are interested please send over your CV and I will give feedback as soon as possible.
